# Attacking a Social Network by Inducing Overperception of Maladaptive Behaviors
This repository contains code and data for the paper "Attacking a Social Network by Inducing Overperception of Maladaptive Behaviors." We make the code and data available for replication of the main results of the paper.

We uploaded three files to this repository:

**maximizing_overperception.cpp**: This is the main file that generates the data for the demonstration featured in the paper. 
**maximizing_overperception_data.csv**: This is the data generated by the C++ file above that is plotted in the paper.
**maximizing_overperception_plotting.py**: This code generates Figure 1 for the paper. Figure 1 displays the main results of the demonstration.
